meta.name: Confluence: 4+ signal groups
meta.desc: Stocks firing bullish scans in at least 4 of the 7 groups (momentum, breakouts, volume, trend, price action, oscillators, relative strength) today — independent confirmation, the day's strongest shortlist. Broad lists (trend template, ADX, leaders near highs, high-octane, swing leaders) don't count. Open a stock to see every scan it is in.

meta.name: 4% breakout day
meta.desc: Up 4% or more today on volume above yesterday's — Pradeep Bonde's momentum-burst trigger.

meta.name: Momentum burst: +20% in 5 days
meta.desc: Gained 20% or more over the last 5 sessions. Fast movers; check for news before chasing.

meta.name: Gap up held
meta.desc: Opened 2%+ above yesterday's close, never filled yesterday's high, and closed above the open.

meta.name: RS rating jump
meta.desc: RS rating up 15+ points in a week to 70 or higher — fresh relative-strength surge.

meta.name: Leaders near highs
meta.desc: RS 90+ and within 5% of the 52-week high.

meta.name: Power trend
meta.desc: Low above the 21 EMA for 10 straight sessions, 21 EMA above the 50 DMA, 50 DMA rising for 5 sessions, and an up close today (Morales & Kacher). The strongest kind of trend — buy pullbacks, don't short it.

meta.name: Ants (steady accumulation)
meta.desc: Up on 12 or more of the last 15 sessions, +20% over those 15 sessions, with average volume 20%+ above the prior 50 sessions (Morales & Kacher) — institutions buying day after day.

meta.name: High-octane leaders
meta.desc: Average daily range 5% or more, RS 90+, above the 21 EMA and 50 DMA and within 10% of the 52-week high — the fast movers swing traders want (Deepvue 'High Octane RS'; thresholds raised for Indian small caps).

meta.name: Swing leaders: 3, 6 and 12 months
meta.desc: In the top 10% of the universe on 3-month, 6-month AND 12-month return, and above the 21 EMA (Mike Webster's swing-trading list).

meta.name: Episodic pivot
meta.desc: Gapped up 10% or more on at least 3× average volume and held the gap (close no more than 2% under the open), after a quiet quarter (not up more than 30% in the prior 3 months). Pradeep Bonde's EP — usually news-driven; check the news.

meta.name: Buyable gap up
meta.desc: Opened above yesterday's high by at least 0.75 × ATR, volume 1.5× average or more, closed in the upper half of the day's range and not below the open by more than 1% (Gil Morales). Stop just under the gap-day low.

meta.name: New 52-week closing high
meta.desc: Closed above the highest close of the previous 252 sessions.

meta.name: Highest close in 2 years
meta.desc: Today's close is the highest of the full ~2-year history held for the site.

meta.name: 52-week high, strong close
meta.desc: New 52-week closing high with the close in the top third of the day's range — buyers held it into the bell (Deepvue's DCR rule).

meta.name: Green line breakout (all-time high)
meta.desc: Closed above the highest price in the stock's entire listed history, on volume at least 1.2× average and a close in the upper half of the day's range. No overhead supply at all.

meta.name: 3 weeks tight
meta.desc: The last three weekly closes (this week's so far included) within 1.5% of each other, in a Stage-2 uptrend (William O'Neil). Buy point: above the high of the tight area.

meta.name: Launch pad
meta.desc: 10 EMA, 21 EMA and 50 DMA bunched within 2% of each other with price above the 21 EMA, 50 DMA above the 200 DMA and within 10% of the 52-week high — energy stored before a move (Deepvue).

meta.name: IPO high breakout
meta.desc: Listed within the last year (10+ sessions ago) and closed above its highest price since listing, on 1.5× average volume — new leaders often start here.

meta.name: Darvas box breakout
meta.desc: Prior 20-day range no wider than 15%, closed above the box top on 1.5× average volume.

meta.name: Bollinger band breakout
meta.desc: Closed above the upper Bollinger band (20, 2) on 1.5× average volume.

meta.name: Stage 2 breakout (Weinstein)
meta.desc: Crossed above the 30-week (150-day) average in the last 5 sessions, average flat or rising, close above 50 DMA.

meta.name: Volatility contraction (VCP)
meta.desc: Stage-2 trend within 15% of the 52-week high, with three successively tighter ranges (sessions 40–20, 20–10, last 10), the last one 10% or less, and volume drying up. Minervini's VCP — watch for the breakout above the tight range.

meta.name: Volume spike up
meta.desc: Volume at least 3× the 50-day average and price up 2% or more today.

meta.name: Pocket pivot
meta.desc: Up day whose volume beats the largest down-day volume of the prior 10 sessions, closing above the 10 and 50 DMA within 15% of the 52-week high (Morales & Kacher).

meta.name: Highest volume in a year (up day)
meta.desc: Today's volume is the largest of the past 252 sessions and the stock closed up.

meta.name: Volume dry-up near highs
meta.desc: 5-day average volume ≤ 50% of the 50-day average while the stock holds within 10% of its high above the 50 DMA — supply exhausted.

meta.name: Trend template (Minervini)
meta.desc: Passes all 8 Minervini trend conditions with RS ≥ 70.

meta.name: Golden cross
meta.desc: 50 DMA crossed above the 200 DMA in the last 5 sessions.

meta.name: 20 EMA crossed above 50 EMA
meta.desc: Bullish crossover in the last 3 sessions, price above the 20 EMA.

meta.name: Pullback to 20 EMA in uptrend
meta.desc: Stage-2 stock with RS ≥ 70 whose low tagged the 20 EMA (within 1%) today and closed above it.

meta.name: Pullback to 50 DMA in uptrend
meta.desc: Stage-2 stock with RS ≥ 70 whose low tagged the 50 DMA (within 1.5%) and closed above it.

meta.name: Supertrend turned bullish
meta.desc: Supertrend (10, 3) flipped from sell to buy in the last 2 sessions.

meta.name: Strong trend (ADX)
meta.desc: ADX(14) ≥ 25 and rising over 5 sessions with +DI above −DI — a trend with real strength.

meta.name: NR7 in uptrend
meta.desc: Narrowest daily range of the last 7 sessions in a Stage-2 stock (Crabel) — a volatility pause that often precedes expansion.

meta.name: Inside day in uptrend
meta.desc: Today's high and low sit inside yesterday's range, in a Stage-2 stock with RS ≥ 70.

meta.name: Power of 3
meta.desc: In one up session the stock started below the 10 EMA, 21 EMA and 50 DMA (low under all three) and closed above all three — a decisive reclaim (Deepvue).

meta.name: EMA reclaim (wedge pop)
meta.desc: Closed back above the 10 and 21 EMA after at least 3 of the previous 5 closes below the 21 EMA, on 1.5× average volume, with the 50 DMA above the 200 DMA (Oliver Kell's wedge pop / EMA crossback).

meta.name: Bullish outside day
meta.desc: Today's range engulfs yesterday's (higher high and lower low), closed up, in the top 30% of the range, on above-average volume — a reversal of control to buyers.

meta.name: Open = low, strong close
meta.desc: Opened at the day's low (no dip below the open) and closed 2%+ above it on above-average volume — buyers in control from the first trade.

meta.name: Hammer at the 50 DMA
meta.desc: Hammer candle (lower wick at least twice the body, small upper wick) whose low tested the 50 DMA and closed above it, in a Stage-2 uptrend — support confirmed.

meta.name: Double inside day
meta.desc: Two inside days in a row in a Stage-2 uptrend — a tighter coil than a single inside day. Buy the break of the mother bar's high.

meta.name: Bull snort
meta.desc: After 2+ down closes in the prior 3 sessions, a 3%+ up day on at least 2× average volume closing in the top quarter of its range, above the 200 DMA (Oliver Kell) — a forceful turn.

meta.name: RSI crossed above 60
meta.desc: RSI(14) crossed up through 60 today with price above the 50 DMA — momentum regime shift (Andrew Cardwell's range rules).

meta.name: RSI oversold bounce
meta.desc: RSI(14) crossed back above 30 in the last 2 sessions while the stock is still above its 200 DMA — a pullback in a long-term uptrend, not a falling knife.

meta.name: MACD bullish cross above zero
meta.desc: MACD (12, 26) crossed above its 9-day signal in the last 2 sessions while above the zero line.

meta.name: Bollinger squeeze
meta.desc: Bollinger band width at its narrowest in 120 sessions with price above the 50 DMA — coiled for a move (John Bollinger).

meta.name: RS line new 1-month high before price
meta.desc: RS line vs NIFTY 500 at a new 1-month high while price is still 2%+ below its own 1-month closing high, RS rating 70+ — strength showing before the breakout (Deepvue 'RS New Highs Before Price').

meta.name: RS line new 3-month high before price
meta.desc: RS line vs NIFTY 500 at a new 3-month high while price is still 2%+ below its own 3-month closing high, RS rating 70+ — strength showing before the breakout (Deepvue 'RS New Highs Before Price').

meta.name: RS line new 6-month high before price
meta.desc: RS line vs NIFTY 500 at a new 6-month high while price is still 2%+ below its own 6-month closing high, RS rating 70+ — strength showing before the breakout (Deepvue 'RS New Highs Before Price').

meta.name: RS line new 12-month high before price
meta.desc: The stock's relative-strength line vs NIFTY 500 hit a 52-week high while price is still below its own high — a classic leadership tell (O'Neil's 'blue dot').

meta.name: Up while market fell
meta.desc: Up 1% or more today while NIFTY 500 fell, RS ≥ 80 and volume above average — buying under pressure.

meta.name: 4% breakdown day
meta.desc: Down 4% or more today on volume above yesterday's. Exit check on holdings.

meta.name: Leader down on volume
meta.desc: RS 80+ stock down 2% or more on at least 1.5× average volume — distribution in a leader. Check if you hold it.

meta.name: 20 EMA crossed below 50 EMA
meta.desc: Bearish crossover in the last 3 sessions, price below the 20 EMA.

meta.name: Broke below 200 DMA on volume
meta.desc: Crossed below the 200 DMA in the last 3 sessions, today's volume ≥ 1.5× average.

meta.name: Death cross
meta.desc: 50 DMA crossed below the 200 DMA in the last 5 sessions.

meta.name: New 52-week closing low
meta.desc: Closed below the lowest close of the previous 252 sessions.

meta.name: Gap down not filled
meta.desc: Opened 2%+ below yesterday's close, stayed below yesterday's low, and closed below the open.
